name: Tatuus T-421-F1A
designer: Tatuus Automobili with the F1 Academy technical team
chassisConstruction: Carbon-fibre monocoque with side anti-intrusion panels, steel halo and wheel tethers; FIA 2021 safety compliant
frontSuspension: Double wishbone, pushrod operated, with adjustable dampers
rearSuspension: Double wishbone, pushrod operated, with adjustable dampers
transmission: Sadev bespoke six-speed longitudinal sequential gearbox; Magneti Marelli electric paddle shift
fuel: Series-controlled fuel; the public technical specification does not state a grade
lubricants: Series-controlled lubricants; the public technical specification does not state a supplier
tyres: Pirelli 200/540-13 front and 250/575-13 rear; slick and wet compounds
aero: F1 Academy-specific carbon-composite front and rear wings designed to promote overtaking
electronics: Combined ECU, GCU and data logger with high-speed data acquisition; no telemetry
